definition: n. the territory occupied by one of the constituent administrative districts of a nation / n. the way something is with respect to its main attributes
translation: n. 州, 状态, 情形, 国家, 政府, 领土, 国务, 社会地位； a. 国家的, 正式的, 礼仪用的, 州的
mnemonic: stat 像 stand 的骨架：站住的一刻就是状态 state。

definition: n. a message that is stated or declared; a communication (oral or written) setting forth particulars or facts etc / n. (music) the presentation of a musical theme
translation: n. 陈述, 指令, 声明； [计] 程序语句; 语句
mnemonic: state + ment：把状态说出来就是 statement 陈述。

definition: n. the relative position or standing of things or especially persons in a society
translation: n. 状态, 情形, 地位, 要人身份； [计] 状态
mnemonic: stat 站在哪个位置，status 就是身份和状态。

definition: n. a branch of applied mathematics concerned with the collection and interpretation of quantitative data and the use of probability theory to estimate population parameters
translation: n. 统计学, 统计资料； [计] 统计信息
mnemonic: stat 状态 + 数字汇总，statistics 就是统计。

definition: n. a sculpture representing a human or animal
translation: vt. 以雕像装饰； n. 雕像

definition: a. of or relating to statistics
translation: a. 统计的, 统计上的, 统计学的； [经] 统计的, 统计学的

definition: n. a crackling or hissing noise caused by electrical interference / n. angry criticism
translation: n. 静电, 静电干扰； a. 静态的, 静止的, 固有的, 静电的

definition: s. standing still / s. not capable of being moved
translation: a. 不动的, 静止的, 不变的, 固定的, 停留的； [计] 定常, 定态, 固定的

definition: n. a man who is a respected leader in national or international affairs
translation: n. 政治家

definition: n. paper cut to an appropriate size for writing letters; usually with matching envelopes
translation: n. 文具, 信纸； [法] 文具

definition: v. give what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance / v. determine (what is to happen in certain contingencies), especially by including a proviso condition or stipulation
translation: vt. 提供, 供应, 规定, 预备； vi. 作准备, 抚养, 规定
mnemonic: pro(提前) + vide(看) -> 提前看到需求并备齐提供 -> 提供，供给，规定。

definition: a. careful and sensible; marked by sound judgment
translation: a. 审慎的, 三思而后行的, 精明的, 节俭的
mnemonic: provident 的缩写 -> 提前算准小心行事的 -> 谨慎的，深谋远虑的。

definition: n. discretion in practical affairs
translation: n. 审慎, 慎重, 精明, 节俭

definition: v. have as a part, be made up out of / v. consider as part of something
translation: vt. 包括, 把...算入, 包住； [计] DOS内部命令:在CONFIG.SYS文件的一个配置块中包含另一配置块的内容
mnemonic: in + clude 关进去，把内容关进来就是 include。

definition: v. bring to a close / v. reach a conclusion after a discussion or deliberation
translation: vt. 结束, 作结论, 推断； vi. 结束, 推断
mnemonic: con + clude 合上，讨论合上就是 conclude 得出结论。

definition: v. prevent from being included or considered or accepted / v. prevent from entering; shut out
translation: vt. 除外, 排除, 排斥； [医] 除外(诊断)
mnemonic: ex + clude 关在外面，exclude 就是排除。

definition: v. make impossible, especially beforehand
translation: vt. 预先排除, 预防, 阻止, 妨碍； [法] 预防, 排除, 消除

definition: n. a group of people living in a particular local area / n. common ownership
translation: n. 社区, 公众, 共有, 共同体； [经] 公众, 共有, 社会
mnemonic: commun 表共同，community 是共同生活的人群。

definition: v. transmit information / v. transmit thoughts or feelings
translation: vt. 显露, 传达, 感染； vi. 通讯
mnemonic: commun 共同 + ate，让信息共同流动就是 communicate。

definition: a. relating to human society and its members / a. living together or enjoying life in communities or organized groups
translation: a. 社会的, 群居的, 社交的； n. 联欢会
mnemonic: soci 表伙伴，social 是和伙伴相处的社会性。

definition: n. an extended social group having a distinctive cultural and economic organization / n. the fashionable elite
translation: n. 社会；社交界；交往；社团
mnemonic: soci 伙伴集合起来就是 society 社会。

definition: n. a person who joins with others in some activity or endeavor / n. a person with subordinate membership in a society, institution, or commercial enterprise
translation: n. 同伴, 伙伴, 关联的事物； vt. 使联合, 使发生联系
mnemonic: as + soci + ate，和伙伴连在一起就是 associate。

definition: n. a formal organization of people or groups of people / n. the act of consorting with or joining with others
translation: n. 协会； [计] 关联
mnemonic: associate 的组织名词，association 是连结成的协会。

definition: n. a political theory advocating state ownership of industry / n. an economic system based on state ownership of capital
translation: n. 社会主义, 社会主义运动

definition: n. the study and classification of human societies
translation: n. 社会学； [医] 社会学

definition: n. a party of people assembled to promote sociability and communal activity / a. inclined to or conducive to companionship with others
translation: a. 好交际的, 社交的, 过社会生活的； n. 联谊会

definition: n. something that results / v. issue or terminate (in a specified way, state, etc.); end
translation: n. 结果, 成绩, 答案； vi. 产生, 结果, 致使
mnemonic: re + sult 像事情跳出来，结果就是 result。

definition: n. close fighting during the culmination of a military attack / n. a threatened or attempted physical attack by someone who appears to be able to cause bodily harm if not stopped
translation: n. 攻击, 袭击； vt. 袭击, 攻击

definition: n. a deliberately offensive act or something producing the effect of deliberate disrespect
translation: n. 侮辱, 无礼, 损害； vt. 损害, 侮辱, 攻击
mnemonic: in + sult，把坏话甩进去就是 insult 侮辱。

definition: v. take into consideration for exemplifying purposes / v. show consideration for; take into account
translation: v. 考虑, 思考, 认为
mnemonic: con + sider 像一起看星星，反复看就是 consider。

definition: n. the process of giving careful thought to something / n. a discussion of a topic (as in a meeting)
translation: n. 考虑, 原因； [法] 考虑, 思考, 报酬
mnemonic: consider 后形成的名词，consideration 是认真考虑。

definition: n. a general conscious awareness / n. the meaning of a word or expression; the way in which a word or expression or situation can be interpreted
translation: n. 感应, 感觉, 感官, 意识, 观念, 情理, 知觉, 理智； vt. 感觉, 觉察, 检测
mnemonic: sense 像 sensor，感官收到的就是 sense。

definition: a. responsive to physical stimuli / a. being susceptible to the attitudes, feelings, or circumstances of others
translation: a. 敏感的, 易感的, 灵敏的, 感光的； [机] 敏感的, 灵敏的, 感度高的
mnemonic: sense + tive，容易感到变化就是 sensitive。

definition: n. agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole
translation: n. 合意, 一致, 同感； [计] 合意
mnemonic: con + sens(感觉/感知) + us -> 大家感觉达成一致 -> 共识，一致意见。

definition: n. an unelaborated elementary awareness of stimulation / n. a general feeling of excitement and heightened interest
translation: n. 感觉, 轰动； [医] 感觉

definition: n. a message that seems to convey no meaning / s. having no intelligible meaning
translation: n. 无意义的事, 荒谬言行, 荒唐
mnemonic: non + sense，没有 sense 就是 nonsense 胡话。

definition: a. able to feel or perceive / s. readily perceived by the senses
translation: a. 有感觉的, 敏感的, 明智的； [医] 可感觉的
mnemonic: sense + ible，能讲得通就是 sensible 明智。

definition: n. education imparted in a series of lessons or meetings / n. a connected series of events or actions or developments
translation: n. 课程, 路线, 过程, 一道菜, 道路； v. 追, (使)跑

definition: n. a quality of spirit that enables you to face danger or pain without showing fear
translation: n. 勇气, 胆量

definition: a. of textures that are rough to the touch or substances consisting of relatively large particles / s. lacking refinement or cultivation or taste
translation: a. 粗糙的, 下等的, 粗俗的； [计] 粗略的

definition: v. be left; of persons, questions, problems, results, evidence, etc.
translation: vi. 保持, 逗留, 剩余； [法] 停留, 居住, 继续

definition: a. continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place / s. not capable of being reversed or returned to the original condition
translation: a. 永久的, 不变的, 固定的, 持久的； n. 烫发
mnemonic: per + manent 像一直留在原位，permanent 是永久的。

definition: n. an impression (especially one that is artificial or contrived) / n. the central meaning or theme of a speech or literary work
translation: n. 结果, 影响, 效果, 印象； vt. 实行, 引起, 完成
mnemonic: ef + fect 做出来的结果就是 effect 效果。

definition: v. add details, as to an account or idea; clarify the meaning of and discourse in a learned way, usually in writing / v. produce from basic elements or sources; change into a more developed product
translation: a. 精细的, 详尽的, 精心计划(或制作)的； vt. 详细地说明, 用心地制作, 发挥
mnemonic: e(出) + labor(劳动/心血) + ate -> 倾注大量心血精雕细琢的 -> 精心制作的，详述。

definition: v. put out or expel from a place / v. leave an aircraft rapidly, using an ejection seat or capsule
translation: vt. 逐放, 放逐, 喷射； [化] 排出

definition: n. the first of two or the first mentioned of two / a. referring to the first of two things or persons mentioned (or the earlier one or ones of several); I prefer the former version to the latter one"
translation: a. 从前的, 前者的； n. 起形成作用的人(或物), 模型, 样板
mnemonic: form 表形状，former 是之前成形的那个。

definition: n. a change for the better as a result of correcting abuses / n. a campaign aimed to correct abuses or malpractices
translation: n. 改革, 改正, 改造； vt. 改革, 改过, 革新, 重整
mnemonic: re + form，重新塑形就是 reform 改革。

definition: v. impart knowledge of some fact, state or affairs, or event to / v. give character or essence to
translation: vt. 通知, 使了解, 使充满； vi. 提供资料, 告发
mnemonic: in + form，把信息放进脑中成形就是 inform 通知。

definition: v. subject to a mathematical transformation / v. change or alter in form, appearance, or nature
translation: vt. 使转换, 改变, 改造, 使...变形； vi. 改变, 转化, 变换
mnemonic: trans + form，跨过去换形就是 transform 转变。

definition: a. being in accord with established forms and conventions and requirements (as e.g. of formal dress) / s. characteristic of or befitting a person in authority
translation: a. 正式的, 形式的, 礼仪的, 拘于礼节的, 拘谨的； n. 正式的社交活动
mnemonic: form + al，有固定形状和规矩就是 formal 正式。

definition: n. clothing of distinctive design worn by members of a particular group as a means of identification / v. provide with uniforms
translation: n. 制服； a. 统一的, 一律的, 始终如一的
mnemonic: uni + form，一个形状就是 uniform 制服或统一的。

definition: n. an arrangement of people or things acting as a unit / n. the act of fabricating something in a particular shape
translation: n. 形成, 构造, 编队； [医] 形成, 结构
mnemonic: form + ation，形成出来的结构就是 formation。

definition: n. a group of symbols that make a mathematical statement / n. a conventionalized statement expressing some fundamental principle
translation: n. 客套语, 公式, 准则； [计] 公式
mnemonic: form + ula，固定成形的表达就是 formula 公式。

definition: n. the organization of information according to preset specifications (usually for computer processing) / n. the general appearance of a publication
translation: n. 开本, 版式, 形式, 格式； vt. 格式化

definition: v. prepare according to a formula
translation: vt. 用公式表示, 明确叙述, 制订； [机] 公式化, 公式表示
mnemonic: formula(公式/规则) + ate -> 用明确严谨的系统语言表述 -> 制定，构想，确切表达。

definition: v. be similar, be in line with
translation: vt. 使一致, 使遵守, 使符合； vi. 一致, 符合, 适应
mnemonic: con + form(形状) -> 依照标准模子成形 -> 符合，顺应。

definition: n. a substance prepared according to a formula / n. the style of expressing yourself
translation: n. 系统陈述, 公式化, 配制； [化] 表述; 数学表述; 数式化; 数学表述

definition: v. make formless / v. become misshapen
translation: vt. 使残缺, 使变形； vi. 变形

definition: v require as useful, just, or proper / v consider obligatory; request and expect
translation: vt. 需要, 命令, 要求； [法] 需要, 要求, 命令
mnemonic: re + quire 像反复询问，require 是要求。

definition: v. locate (a moving entity) by means of a tracking system such as radar / v. win something through one's efforts
translation: vt. 获得, 学到； [电] 目标锁定
mnemonic: ac + quire，通过追问和努力取得就是 acquire。

definition: s. intense or sharp / s. lavishly elegant and refined
translation: a. 精致的, 细腻的, 敏锐的

definition: v inquire about / v conduct an inquiry or investigation of
translation: v. 询问

definition: n. use of physical or mental energy; hard work
translation: n. 努力, 成就

definition: a. providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (`comfy' is informal) / a. free from stress or conducive to mental ease; having or affording peace of mind
translation: a. 舒服的, 轻松的； n. 盖被
mnemonic: comfort + able，能带来安稳感就是 comfortable。

definition: n. a state of being relaxed and feeling no pain / n. a feeling of freedom from worry or disappointment
translation: n. 舒适, 安慰, 安慰者； vt. 安慰
mnemonic: com + fort 像一起加固内心，comfort 是安慰。

definition: s. available when required or as promised
translation: a. 即将来临的； n. 来临

definition: n. a period of fourteen consecutive days
translation: n. 两星期

definition: n. a magnitude or frequency relative to a time unit / n. amount of a charge or payment relative to some basis
translation: n. 比率, 率, 速度, 价格, 费用, 等级； vt. 估价, 认为, 鉴定等级, 责骂
mnemonic: rate 像给速度和等级打分，rate 是比率或评价。

definition: n. the relative magnitudes of two quantities (usually expressed as a quotient)
translation: n. 比, 比率； [医] 比, 比率, 比例
mnemonic: ratio 是 rate 的数字关系版：两个量相互比较。

definition: a. consistent with or based on or using reason / a. capable of being expressed as a quotient of integers
translation: a. 理性的, 合理的； n. 有理数
mnemonic: ratio + nal，按比例和理性推就是 rational。

definition: n. the military forces of a nation / a. of or relating to the study of the principles of warfare
translation: n. 军队； a. 军事的, 军人的, 适于战争的

definition: n. a militant reformer / s. disposed to warfare or hard-line policies
translation: a. 好战的

definition: n. a member of the Union Army during the American Civil War / n. any federal law-enforcement officer
translation: a. 联邦的, 联合的, 同盟的； [法] 联邦的, 联邦制的, 联盟的
mnemonic: feder(联盟/条约) + al -> 依据联邦盟约建立的 -> 联邦的，联合的。

definition: n. an organization formed by merging several groups or parties / n. the act of constituting a political unity out of a number of separate states or colonies or provinces so that each member retains th
translation: n. 联邦, 联合, 联盟； [法] 联邦, 联盟, 联邦政府

definition: n. a numerical quantity measured or assigned or computed / n. the quality (positive or negative) that renders something desirable or valuable
translation: n. 价值, 价格, 购买力, 评价, 估价, 计算结果； vt. 评价, 估价, 重视
mnemonic: value 是你愿意标价保留的东西：价值。

definition: v. form a critical opinion of
translation: vt. 评估, 评价, 赋值
mnemonic: e + value，把价值估出来就是 evaluate 评估。

definition: a. well grounded in logic or truth or having legal force / s. still legally acceptable
translation: a. 有确实根据的, 有法律效力的, 正当的, 正确的； [经] 有效的
mnemonic: valid 像 value 被认可，valid 是有效的。

definition: n. someone who is incapacitated by a chronic illness or injury / v. force to retire, remove from active duty, as of firemen
translation: n. 病人, 残废者； a. 有病的, 无效的
mnemonic: in(不) + valid(有力的/有效的) -> 失去了法律效力的 -> 无效的，作废的。

definition: n. any of several international socialist organizations / a. concerning or belonging to all or at least two or more nations
translation: a. 国际的； n. 国别设定
mnemonic: inter + national，国家之间的就是 international。

definition: a. marked by or showing unaffected simplicity and lack of guile or worldly experience / s. inexperienced
translation: a. 天真的, 纯真的, 幼稚的

definition: n. people having common origins or traditions and often comprising a nation / n. the status of belonging to a particular nation by birth or naturalization
translation: n. 国籍, 国家, 民族性； [法] 国家, 民族, 国民
mnemonic: national + ity，一个人的国家属性就是 nationality。

definition: n. the period of European history at the close of the Middle Ages and the rise of the modern world; a cultural rebirth from the 14th through the middle of the 17th centuries
translation: n. 复活, 复兴, 文艺复兴； a. 文艺复兴的

definition: n. something done (usually as opposed to something said) / n. the state of being active
translation: n. 行动, 活动, 动作, 作用, 战斗, 行为, 诉讼； vt. 对...起诉
mnemonic: act + ion，做出来的动作就是 action。

definition: a. marked by strict and particular and complete accordance with fact
translation: a. 精确的, 准确的, 精密的； vt. 强求, 急需
mnemonic: ex + act，做得完全对准就是 exact 精确。

definition: n. the act of transacting within or between groups (as carrying on commercial activities)
translation: n. 交易, 办理, 学报, 和解协议； [计] 事务处理

definition: n. a hypothetical description of a complex entity or process / n. a type of product
translation: n. 模型, 模范, 模特儿； a. 模范的, 作模型用的
mnemonic: model 是可照着做的模型。

definition: n. a particular functioning condition or arrangement / n. any of various fixed orders of the various diatonic notes within an octave
translation: n. 模态, 调式, 样式, 文体, 状态, 方式, 风尚； [计] 方式; DOS外部命令:设定各种设备命令
mnemonic: mode 是做事的方式和模式。

definition: a. marked by simplicity; having a humble opinion of yourself / s. not large but sufficient in size or amount
translation: a. 谦逊的, 羞怯的, 端庄的, 适度的； [经] 适当的

definition: v. make less severe or harsh or extreme / v. add a modifier to a constituent
translation: vt. 修正, 变更, 修饰, 缓和, 减轻； vi. 被修改
mnemonic: mod + ify，调整模式就是 modify 修改。

definition: n. articles of commerce
translation: n. 农产品, 商品, 有用的物品； [经] 商品, 货物, 日用品
mnemonic: com + mod(适宜/度量) + ity -> 适合交易的物品 -> 商品，日用品。

definition: n. the particular portion of space occupied by something / n. a way of regarding situations or topics etc.
translation: n. 位置, 地位, 身分, 形势, 姿势, 立场, 职位, 状态, 阵地； vt. 安置, 决定...的位置
mnemonic: posit 放置，position 是被放到的位置。

definition: n. the primary form of an adjective or adverb; denotes a quality without qualification, comparison, or relation to increase or diminution / n. a film showing a photographic image whose tones correspon
translation: a. 肯定的, 积极的, 有把握的； [医] 正的, 阳性的
mnemonic: posit 放上去的方向感，positive 是正向或确定。

definition: v compel to behave in a certain way / v impose something unpleasant
translation: vt. 征(税), 把...强加于, 以...欺骗； vi. 利用, 欺骗, 施加影响
mnemonic: im + pose，把东西放到别人身上就是 impose 强加。

definition: n. the spatial property resulting from the arrangement of parts in relation to each other and to the whole / n. a mixture of ingredients
translation: n. 作文, 创作, 组成； [化] 成分; 组成
mnemonic: com + position，把部分放到一起就是 composition 作文或构成。

definition: n. the phenomenon of sediment or gravel accumulating / n. money deposited in a bank or some similar institution
translation: n. 存款, 定金, 堆积物； vt. 存放, 堆积
mnemonic: de + posit，向下放进去就是 deposit 存放或押金。

definition: n. a special offering (usually temporary and at a reduced price) that is featured in advertising / n. a dish or meal given prominence in e.g. a restaurant
translation: n. 专辑, 专车, 号外, 特别的东西, 负有特别任务的人员； a. 特别的, 专门的, 特殊的, 额外的, 附加的, 特别亲密的
mnemonic: spec 看见特别之处，special 就是特殊。

definition: n. a medicine that has a mitigating effect on a specific disease / a. (sometimes followed by `to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique
translation: n. 特效药, 特性； a. 特殊的, 明确的, 具有特效的, 特定地, 具体地
mnemonic: spec + ific，看准某一项就是 specific 具体的。

definition: n. (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed / n. a specific kind of something
translation: n. 种, 类, 外形； [医] 茶剂; 种
mnemonic: spec 看外形分组，species 是物种。

definition: n. an expert who is devoted to one occupation or branch of learning / n. practices one branch of medicine
translation: n. 专门医师, 专家； a. 专业的, 专家的
mnemonic: special + ist，专看某一类问题的人就是 specialist。

definition: v. become more focus on an area of activity or field of study / v. suit to a special purpose
translation: vt. 使特殊化, 列举, 特别指明, 限定...的范围； vi. 成为专家, 专攻
mnemonic: special + ize，把注意力集中到专门领域就是 specialize。

definition: v. decide upon or fix definitely / v. determine the essential quality of
translation: vt. 详列, 指定, 说明； [计] 指定

definition: n. a detailed description of design criteria for a piece of work / n. naming explicitly
translation: n. 规格, 详述, 详细说明书； [计] 规范; 形式说明; 说明; 说明书; 规格

definition: n an asset of special worth or utility / n a distinguishing trait
translation: n. 专长, 擅长, 特种技能, 详细说明, 特性, 特产, 专业； [化] 特制品

definition: n. the activity of providing for or maintaining by supplying with money or necessities / n. aiding the cause or policy or interests of
translation: n. 支持, 支撑, 援助, 供养, 支撑物； vt. 支援, 支撑, 帮助, 支持, 忍受, 供养, 证实
mnemonic: sup + port，从下面托住搬运就是 support 支持。

definition: n. commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country / v. sell or transfer abroad
translation: n. 输出品, 输出； vt. 输出, 出口
mnemonic: ex + port，运出去就是 export 出口。

definition: n. commodities (goods or services) bought from a foreign country / n. an imported person brought from a foreign country
translation: n. 进口货, 进口, 输入, 含义, 重要性； vt. 输入, 引入, 进口, 含...的意思, 重要
mnemonic: im + port，运进来就是 import 进口。

definition: n. an exchange of molecules (and their kinetic energy and momentum) across the boundary between adjacent layers of a fluid or across cell membranes / v. move something or somebody around; usually over
translation: n. 运输, 运输工具, 激动, 狂喜, 流放犯； vt. 传送, 运输, 流放
mnemonic: trans + port，跨地点搬运就是 transport 运输。

definition: n. a small light typewriter; usually with a case in which it can be carried / a. easily or conveniently transported
translation: a. 可携带的, 可搬运的, 可移动的； [计] 可移植的
mnemonic: port + able，能搬走的就是 portable 便携的。

definition: n. a person employed to carry luggage and supplies / n. United States writer of novels and short stories (1890-1980)
translation: n. 大楼管理员, 门房, 搬运工人, 侍者, 服务员； [化] 搬运车; 搬运工人

definition: v. give a description of

definition: v issue commands or orders for

mnemonic: pre + scrib，提前写好要求就是 prescribe 开处方或规定。

definition: v. offer to buy, as of stocks and shares / v. adopt as a belief
translation: vt. 捐献, 签署； vi. 赞成, 同意, 捐款, 预订, 认购
mnemonic: sub(在底下) + scribe(签名) -> 在合同底部签名认购支持 -> 订阅，签署，赞同。

definition: n. a person who requires medical care / a. enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance
translation: n. 病人, 承受者； a. 忍耐的, 容忍的, 有耐性的, 坚忍的
mnemonic: pat 表承受，patient 是能忍受的人或病人。

definition: a. lacking in energy or will / s. peacefully resistant in response to injustice
translation: a. 消极的, 被动的, 冷漠的, 顺从的, 无源的； [医] 被动的
mnemonic: pass 表承受，passive 是被动承受。

definition: a. able to exist and perform in harmonious or agreeable combination / a. capable of being used with or connected to other devices or components without modification
translation: a. 能共处的, 可并立的, 适合的； [计] 相容的; 兼容的
mnemonic: com + pati(承受/忍受) + ible -> 能互相容忍共存的 -> 兼容的，合得来的。

definition: s. definite but not specified or identified / a. having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured
translation: a. 确定的, 某一个的, 必然的； [法] 确凿的, 无疑的, 可靠的
mnemonic: certain 是心里已经定住：确定的。

definition: n. a performance of music by players or singers not involving theatrical staging / v. contrive (a plan) by mutual agreement
translation: n. 音乐会, 和声, 一致； vt. 协力, 协调

definition: n. a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts / v. present someone with a certificate
translation: n. 证书, 证明书； vt. 发给证明书, 用证书批准, 用证书证明

definition: n. the state of being certain / n. something that is certain

definition: n. a practical method or art applied to some particular task
translation: n. 技巧, 技术, 方法； [化] 工艺方法; 技巧

definition: n. a pickup truck with a gun mounted on it / a. of or relating to technique or proficiency in a practical skill
translation: a. 技术上的, 专门的, 工业的, 严格根据法律的； [化] 技巧

definition: n. someone whose occupation involves training in a specific technical process / n. someone known for high skill in some intellectual or artistic technique
translation: n. 技师； [化] 技师
mnemonic: tech + nician，处理技术细节的人就是 technician。

definition: n. a subdivision of a particular kind of thing / n. (biology) the taxonomic group whose characteristics are used to define the next higher taxon
translation: n. 类型, 样式, 典型, 榜样, 标志, 符号, 型, 式； vi. 打字

definition: a. exhibiting the qualities or characteristics that identify a group or kind or category / s. conforming to a type
translation: a. 典型的, 象征性的； [医] 典型的
mnemonic: type + ical，符合这一类样式就是 typical 典型。

definition: n. the process whereby a person concentrates on some features of the environment to the (relative) exclusion of others / n. a general interest that leads people to want to know more

definition: n. the branch of medical science that treats disease or injury by operative procedures / n. a room where a doctor or dentist can be consulted

definition: n. a physician who specializes in surgery

definition: n. (physics) a thermodynamic quantity equivalent to the capacity of a physical system to do work; the units of energy are joules or ergs / n. forceful exertion

mnemonic: period 是一段被圈定的时间。

definition: n. a way of doing something, especially a systematic way; implies an orderly logical arrangement (usually in steps)
translation: n. 方法, 办法, 条理, 秩序； [医] [方]法
mnemonic: method 是按路子做事的方法。

translation: n. 国会, 会议, 讨论会； [医] 会议, 会合

definition: n. a position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality / n. a specific identifiable position in a continuum or series or especially in a process
translation: n. 程度, 度数, 学位, 度； [医] 度, 程度

translation: vt. 剥夺, 使丧失； [法] 剥夺, 剥夺, 夺去

translation: n. 批评, 评论, 非难； [法] 批判, 批评, 评论

definition: v. act as a critic
translation: v. 批评, 吹毛求疵, 非难

definition: n. everything that exists anywhere / n. everything stated or assumed in a given discussion

definition: n. (linguistics) a grammatical rule (or other linguistic feature) that is found in all languages / n. (logic) a proposition that asserts something of all members of a class
translation: a. 全世界的, 普遍的, 宇宙的, 通用的； n. 一般概念

definition: n. a piece of poetry / n. a line of metrical text

definition: n. a group's refusal to work in protest against low pay or bad work conditions / n. an attack that is intended to seize or inflict damage on or destroy an objective
translation: n. 罢工, 打击, 殴打； vt. 打, 撞击, 冲击, 侵袭, 取消, 结算, 打掉, 罢工, 刺透, 使生根, 遇见

translation: n. 线, 细绳, 一串, 字符串； vt. 串起, 成串, 收紧, 缚, 扎

definition: v. be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc. / v. take charge of or deal with

definition: v. make available; provide / v. reach outward in space

definition: v. put forward a claim and assert right or possession of
translation: v. 假装, 伪称, 自命, 自称

definition: n. (biology) a taxonomic category consisting of members of a species that differ from others of the same species in minor but heritable characteristics / n. a difference that is usually pleasant
translation: n. 多样, 种类, 变种, 杂耍； [化] 变种

definition: v. be subject to change in accordance with a variable / v. make something more diverse and varied

translation: vt. 使感动, 激发, 启示, 吸入, 鼓舞, 产生, 使生灵感； vi. 吸入, 赋予灵感

mnemonic: e(浮出) + merge(沉浸) -> 从水下浮现出来 -> 浮现，暴露，兴起。

definition: n the combination of two or more commercial companies / n an occurrence that involves the production of a union
translation: n. 合并, 归并； [经] 购并

definition: v become one / v mix together different elements
translation: vt. 使合并, 使消失, 吞没； vi. 合并, 渐渐消失
mnemonic: merge(浸入/融合) -> 汇入一条河流融为一体 -> 合并，吞没，融合。

definition: v. sink below the surface; go under or as if under water / v. cover completely or make imperceptible
translation: vt. 使浸水, 使陷入, 淹没； vi. 潜入水中

definition: v. contribute to some cause / v. be conducive to
translation: vt. 有助于, 捐助, 投稿； vi. 出力, 捐献, 投稿
mnemonic: con + tribute(给予/贡献) -> 奉献自己的一份力量 -> 贡献，促成，投稿。

definition: v. administer or bestow, as in small portions / v. make available
translation: vt. 分配, 散布, 分发； [经] 分配, 分发
mnemonic: dis(分开) + tribute(分配) -> 分发到各个地方 -> 分发，分配，散布。

definition: n. an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of an entity
translation: n. 属性, 标志, 定语； vt. 把...归于, 认为...属于
mnemonic: at + tribute(给予/贡品) -> 把原因归给某人某物 -> 归因于，属性。

definition: n. something given or done as an expression of esteem / n. payment by one nation for protection by another
translation: n. 贡物, 礼物, 颂辞
mnemonic: tribut(给予/贡献) + e -> 表达崇高敬意的颂词或贡品 -> 致敬，颂词，贡品。

definition: v. continue to live through hardship or adversity / v. continue in existence after (an adversity, etc.)
translation: vt. 比...活得长, 生存, 生还, 幸免于； vi. 活下来, 幸存
mnemonic: sur(超越/在...之后) + viv(活) + e -> 大难之后超越死亡活下来 -> 幸存，比...活得长。

definition: v. be brought back to life, consciousness, or strength / v. restore from a depressed, inactive, or unused state
translation: vt. 使苏醒, 使复兴, 使振奋, 回想起, 重播； vi. 苏醒, 复活, 复兴, 恢复精神
mnemonic: re(再次) + viv(生命) + e -> 重新唤醒生命活力 -> 复活，苏醒，使恢复生机。

definition: n. (botany) a plant that completes its entire life cycle within the space of a year / n. a reference book that is published regularly once every year
translation: n. 年刊, 年报； a. 每年的, 一年一次的, 全年的, 一年生的

definition: n. the date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it)
translation: n. 周年纪念

definition: n. a particular course of action intended to achieve a result / n. a mode of conducting legal and parliamentary proceedings
translation: n. 程序, 过程, 手续； [计] 规程; 过程
mnemonic: pro(向前) + ced(走) + ure -> 一步一步向前推进的规范流程 -> 程序，手续，步骤。

definition: n. a group of people or things arranged or following in order / n. the action of following in order
translation: n. 连续, 继承权, 继位, 演替, 地层次序； [法] 继承, 继承权, 继位

definition: n. a regular patron / n. a soldier in the regular army
translation: a. 规则的, 常例的, 有秩序的, 整齐的, 等边的, 定期的, 经常的, 合格的, 常备军的； n. 正规军, 正式队员

definition: n. an authoritative rule / n. the state of being controlled or governed
translation: n. 规则, 管理, 调整； [计] 调整; 规章; 规则; 调节

definition: v. fix or adjust the time, amount, degree, or rate of / v. bring into conformity with rules or principles or usage; impose regulations
translation: vt. 管理, 控制, 调节, 调整, 校准； [经] 控制, 管理
mnemonic: regul(规则/尺子) + ate -> 用尺子规则来约束控制 -> 规范，调节，管理。

definition: n. a power to affect persons or events especially power based on prestige etc / n. causing something without any direct or apparent effort
translation: n. 影响力, 权力, 势力； vt. 影响, 改变
mnemonic: in + flu(流动) + ence -> 潜移默化如水流渗透心田 -> 影响，感化。

definition: n. a substance that is fluid at room temperature and pressure / n. continuous amorphous matter that tends to flow and to conform to the outline of its container: a liquid or a gas
translation: n. 液体, 分泌液, 流体； a. 流动的, 可改变的

definition: n. an affluent person; a person who is financially well off / s. having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value
translation: a. 丰富的, 富裕的； n. 支流, 富人

definition: s. smooth and unconstrained in movement
translation: a. 流利的, 流畅的
mnemonic: flu(流动) + ent -> 像水流一样顺畅无阻的 -> 流利的，流畅的。

definition: s serving no useful purpose; having no excuse for being / s more than is needed, desired, or required
translation: a. 多余的, 过剩的
mnemonic: super(超过) + flu(流动) + ous -> 水流溢出多余无用的 -> 多余的，过剩的。

definition: v. cause to be admitted; of persons to an institution / v. engage in or perform
translation: vt. 委托(托付), 犯罪, 指派...作战, 使承担义务； [法] 犯, 做, 把...交托给

definition: n. large game fish; found in waters of the West Indies / v. consent to, give permission
translation: n. 许可证, 许可, 执照, 通行证； vt. 允许, 容许, 可能, 使放手做

definition: v. refer for judgment or consideration / v. put before
translation: vt. 使服从, 使受到, 委托, 提交, 认为； vi. 屈服, 服从

definition: v prevent from being included or considered or accepted / v leave undone or leave out
translation: vt. 省略, 删除, 疏忽, 遗漏； [化] 省略

definition: n. the appearance of things relative to one another as determined by their distance from the viewer
translation: n. 远景, 透视感, (观察问题的)视角, 透视法, 看法, 透视图； a. 透视的, 透视法的
mnemonic: per(穿透) + spect(看) + ive -> 穿透迷雾看透全局的视野与视角 -> 视角，透视法，远景。

definition: n. (usually preceded by `in') a detail or point / n. an attitude of admiration or esteem
translation: n. 尊敬, 尊重, 问候； vt. 尊敬, 注意, 遵守
mnemonic: re(再次) + spect(看) -> 令人刮目相看心怀敬意 -> 尊敬，尊重，方面。

definition: n. an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave / n. a broad range of related objects or values or qualities or ideas or activities
translation: n. 光谱, 范围, 系列； [化] 光谱

definition: n. a lavishly produced performance / s. characteristic of spectacles or drama
translation: a. 公开展示的, 惊人的, 壮观的； n. 奇观, 惊人之举, 展览物

definition: n. a close observer; someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind)
translation: n. 观众, 目击者, 旁观者

definition: n. an example regarded as typical of its class / n. a bit of tissue or blood or urine that is taken for diagnostic purposes
translation: n. 样品, 标本, 试料； [化] 试样

definition: n. something or someone seen (especially a notable or unusual sight) / n. an elaborate and remarkable display on a lavish scale
translation: n. 引人羡慕的东西, 景象, 眼镜, 场面, 公开展示

definition: n. the ability to comprehend; to understand and profit from experience / n. a unit responsible for gathering and interpreting information about an enemy
translation: n. 智力, 情报, 信息； [医] 智力

definition: a. well articulated or enunciated, and loud enough to be heard distinctly
translation: a. 可理解的, 易理解的, 纯概念性的

definition: n. discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation / n. the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
translation: n. 上下文, 背景, 来龙去脉； n. 上下文
mnemonic: con + text(编织/文本) -> 编织在一起的上下文语境 -> 上下文，背景，环境。

definition: n. the feel of a surface or a fabric / n. the essential quality of something
translation: n. (织物的)密度, (材料等的)结构, 纹理； [化] 纹理

definition: n. a book prepared for use in schools or colleges
translation: n. 教科书

definition: a. of or relating to fabrics or fabric making
translation: n. 纺织品, 纺织业； a. 织的, 纺织的

definition: n. something serving to conceal plans; a fictitious reason that is concocted in order to conceal the real reason
translation: n. 借口, 托词； v. 以...为借口

definition: v. command with authority / v. guide the actors in (plays and films)
translation: a. 直接的, 坦白的； vt. 指示, 指挥, 命令, 导演

definition: v. make right or correct / v. treat a defect
translation: a. 正确的, 合适的； vt. 改正, 订正

definition: a. upright in position or posture
translation: a. 直立的, 竖立的, 笔直的； vt. 使竖立, 使直立, 树立, 建立

definition: n. a parallelogram with four right angles
translation: n. 长方形, 矩形； [化] 矩形

definition: v. math: determine the length of / v. set straight or right
translation: vt. 订正, 矫正, 改正, 调正, 校正, 精馏, 整流； [化] 精馏
mnemonic: rect(正确/笔直) + ify -> 纠偏扶正改正错误 -> 纠正，矫正。

definition: n. close interaction / n. the act of touching physically
translation: n. 联系, 交际, 熟人, 接触； vi. 接触, 联系
mnemonic: con + tact(接触/碰触) -> 彼此碰触联系 -> 联系，接触。

definition: n. a plan for attaining a particular goal
translation: n. 一项战术, 一条策略； a. 战术的, 顺序的, 排列的

definition: s. (of a woman) having the hymen unbroken / s. undamaged in any way
translation: a. 尚未被人碰过的, 原封不动的, 完整的； [医] 完整的, 无伤的

definition: n. a preliminary election where delegates or nominees are chosen / n. one of the main flight feathers projecting along the outer edge of a bird's wing
translation: n. 最主要者, 原色； a. 主要的, 初期的, 根本的, 原始的, 首要的, 基本的

definition: n. a person who belongs to an early stage of civilization / n. a mathematical expression from which another expression is derived
translation: n. 原始人, 早期艺术家； a. 原始的, 上古的
mnemonic: prim(第一/原始) + itive -> 最古老原始第一代的 -> 原始的，早期的。

definition: n. ellipse in which the two axes are of equal length; a plane curve generated by one point moving at a constant distance from a fixed point / n. something approximating the shape of a circle
translation: n. 圆周, 社交圈, 循环, 范围； vt. 围着, 环绕

definition: n. an electrical device that provides a path for electrical current to flow / n. an established itinerary of venues or events that a particular group of people travel to
translation: n. 电路, 环(行)道, 巡回； [计] 线路; 电路
mnemonic: circum(环绕) + it(走) -> 绕了一圈走回原点 -> 电路，巡回，环行。

definition: v. cause to become widely known / v. cause be distributed
translation: v. (使)流通, (使)循环, (使)传播

definition: n. a travelling company of entertainers; including trained animals / n. a performance given by a traveling company of acrobats, clowns, and trained animals
translation: n. 马戏团, 马戏, 竞技场

definition: n. an advertisement (usually printed on a page or in a leaflet) intended for wide distribution / s. describing a circle; moving in a circle
translation: a. 圆形的, 循环的, 间接的； [医] 环状的, 循环的

definition: n. an associate that one works with / n. a person who is member of one's class or profession
translation: n. 同事, 同僚

definition: n (law) a gift of personal property by will
translation: n. 祖先传下来之物, 遗赠物； [经] 遗产, 遗赠物

translation: n. 代表； vt. 委派...为代表

definition: v. report or maintain
translation: vt. 宣称, 主张, 提出, 断言； [法] 断言, 指称, 指证

definition: n. a meeting for execution of a group's functions / n. a meeting devoted to a particular activity
translation: n. 期间, 开庭期, 会议, 学期； [计] 会话, 对话, 会晤, 通用任务程序

definition: n. an unhealthy and compulsive preoccupation with something or someone
translation: n. 困扰, 困扰人的情绪； [医] 强迫观念

definition: n. a servant who is paid to perform menial tasks around the household / a. of concern to or concerning the internal affairs of a nation
translation: a. 家庭的, 国内的, 驯养的； [医] 家庭的, 家用的

definition: n. territory over which rule or control is exercised / n. (mathematics) the set of values of the independent variable for which a function is defined
translation: n. 领域, 领土, 产业, 范围； [计] 域, 区域, 支配命令

definition: n. a concave shape whose distinguishing characteristic is that the concavity faces downward / n. a stadium that has a roof
translation: n. 圆顶； vt. 加圆顶

definition: n. creative writing of recognized artistic value / n. the humanistic study of a body of literature
translation: n. 文学, 文艺, 著作； [经] 广告, 商品介绍等文学

definition: r. in a literal sense / r. (intensifier before a figurative expression) without exaggeration
translation: adv. 逐字地, 按照字面上地, 不夸张地

definition: a. of or relating to or characteristic of literature / s. knowledgeable about literature
translation: a. 文学的, 文艺的, 精通文学的； [法] 文学的, 从事文学的, 从事写作的

definition: n. the ability to read and write
translation: n. 读写能力, 识字, 精通文学
mnemonic: liter(文字) + acy -> 具备认字读写的能力 -> 识字，读写能力。

definition: n. a person who can read and write / a. able to read and write
translation: n. 学者； a. 有读写能力的, 精通文学的, 受过教育的

definition: a. relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area / a. located in or characteristic of a city or city life
translation: a. 都市的, 住在都市的, 习惯于都市的； [法] 城市的, 都市的, 市区的

definition: n. a residential district located on the outskirts of a city
translation: n. 市郊住宅区, 郊区, 边缘

definition: n. something regarded with special favor or liking / s. appealing to the general public
translation: n. 喜欢的事物, 幸运儿； a. 特别受喜爱的, 喜爱的, 宠爱的, 中意的

definition: n. an act of gracious kindness / n. an advantage to the benefit of someone or something
translation: n. 好意, 喜爱； vt. 赐予, 支持, 喜欢, 证实

definition: n. an event that repeats / v. to say, state, or perform again
translation: n. 重复, 反复； vt. 重做, 重复, 复述, 使再现, 复制

definition: v. compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others
translation: vi. 竞争, 对抗

definition: n. a feeling of craving something
translation: n. 食欲, 欲望, 爱好； [医] 食欲

definition: a. properly or sufficiently qualified or capable or efficient / s. adequate for the purpose
translation: a. 能干的, 胜任的, 有效的, 足够的； [经] 有权的, 授权的, 胜任的

definition: v. write a petition for something to somebody; request formally and in writing
translation: n. 请愿, 诉状, 陈情书, 申请, 祈求, 祷文； v. 正式请求, 恳求, 请愿

definition: s continuing forever or indefinitely / s uninterrupted in time and indefinitely long continuing
translation: a. 永久的, 不断的, 无期限的, 没完没了的, 四季开花的； [经] 永远的, 终身的, 持续的

definition: n a force that moves something along / n the act of applying force suddenly
translation: n. 动力, 推动力, 动量； [医] 冲动, 动能, 起始(病)

definition: a. of or relating to the practice of science / a. conforming with the principles or methods used in science
translation: a. 科学的, 系统的, 符合科学规律的； [计] 科学记数法

definition: s. intentionally conceived / a. knowing and perceiving; having awareness of surroundings and sensations and thoughts
translation: a. 有意识的, 知觉的, 觉察的； [医] 有意识的, 清醒的
mnemonic: con + sci(知道/知晓) + ous -> 能够知晓周围状态的 -> 有意识的，觉察的。

definition: s. characterized by extreme care and great effort / a. guided by or in accordance with conscience or sense of right and wrong
translation: a. 有责任心的, 负责的, 本着良心的； [法] 凭良心做的, 有道德感的

definition: n. a device that requires skill for proper use / n. the means whereby some act is accomplished
translation: n. 工具, 手段, 仪器； [化] 仪器

definition: n. an energetic attempt to achieve something / n. strenuous effort
translation: n. 斗争, 努力, 奋斗； vi. 努力, 奋斗, 挣扎

definition: v. make a prediction about; tell in advance
translation: v. 预知, 预言, 预报
mnemonic: pre(提前) + dict(说) -> 事情发生前提前说出 -> 预测，预言。

definition: n. (law) the findings of a jury on issues of fact submitted to it for decision; can be used in formulating a judgment
translation: n. 裁决, 判决, 判断性意见, 定论, 结论； [法] 定论, 判断, 意见
mnemonic: ver(真实) + dict(说/判决) -> 陪审团说出的最终真实裁决 -> 裁决，判决，定论。

definition: n. an authoritative rule / n. a guiding principle
translation: vi. 听写, 口述, 口授； vt. 口述, 使听写, 命令
mnemonic: dict(说话/宣告) + ate -> 口述命令别人遵照记录 -> 口述，命令，决定。

definition: n. speech intended for reproduction in writing / n. matter that has been dictated and transcribed; a dictated passage
translation: n. 听写, 口述, 命令

definition: n. an inquiry into public opinion conducted by interviewing a random sample of people / n. the part of the head between the ears
translation: n. 投票, 民意测验, 选举投票, 投票数, 一组人中的一个, 头颈和后脑部, 鹦鹉； vt. 对...进行民意测验, 获得...票, 剪树枝, 轮询

definition: n. undesirable state of the natural environment being contaminated with harmful substances as a consequence of human activities
translation: n. 污染, 玷污； [化] 污染

definition: v. connect, fasten, or put together two or more pieces / v. be or become joined or united or linked
translation: v. 连接, 联合, 联系

definition: n. an idea that is implied or suggested
translation: n. 含蓄, 内涵

definition: n. an extended fictional work in prose; usually in the form of a story / n. a printed and bound book that is an extended work of fiction
translation: n. 小说, 长篇故事； a. 新奇的, 异常的

definition: n. originality by virtue of being new and surprising
translation: n. 新奇, 新鲜, 新奇的事物

definition: v bring something new to an environment
translation: vi. 改革, 创新
mnemonic: in + nov(新) + ate -> 破旧立新推陈出新 -> 创新，革新。

definition: n the entire amount of income before any deductions are made / n government income due to taxation
translation: n. 收入, 岁入, 税收, 税务局； [经] 岁入, 税收, 税务局
mnemonic: re(回) + ven(来) + ue -> 国家与公司流回囊中的收入 -> 财政收入，税收。

definition: v. get involved, so as to alter or hinder an action, or through force or threat of force / v. be placed or located between other things or extend between spaces and events
translation: vi. 插入, 调停, 干涉； [经] 进场干预
mnemonic: inter(在中间) + vene(走来) -> 走入局中调停干预 -> 干涉，调解，介入。

definition: a. suited to your comfort or purpose or needs
translation: a. 方便的, 合宜的； [法] 适当的, 合理而可行的, 方便的
mnemonic: con + ven(来) + ient -> 大家聚拢走到一起很顺手 -> 便利的，顺手的。

definition: v. discover the location of; determine the place of; find by searching or examining / v. assign a location to
translation: vt. 找出, 设于, 位于； vi. 定居

definition: v. distribute according to a plan or set apart for a special purpose
translation: vt. 分派, 分配； [计] 分配
mnemonic: al(向) + loc(地点/位置) + ate -> 分配到具体位置 -> 分配，拨给。

definition: n a surrounding or nearby region
translation: n. 地方, 所在, 位置； [法] 位置, 场所, 地区

definition: n. an unfortunate mishap; especially one causing damage or injury / n. anything that happens suddenly or by chance without an apparent cause
translation: n. 意外事件, 机遇, 事故, 次要方面； [化] 意外事故; 事故

definition: n. an event that might have been arranged although it was really accidental / n. the quality of occupying the same position or area in space
translation: n. 巧合, 同时发生； [电] 符合计数器

definition: n. the relative frequency of occurrence of something / n. the striking of a light beam on a surface
translation: n. 发生, 发生率, 影响, 负担者, 入射, 倾角； [医] 入射, 发生率, 发生数

definition: n. the act of forcibly dispossessing an owner of property / n. a process whereby a star or planet holds an object in its gravitational field
translation: n. 抓取, 战利品, 捕获之物； vt. 抓取, 获得, 迷住
mnemonic: capt(抓取) + ure -> 抓获俘获 -> 俘获，捕获，夺取。

definition: n. a strip of land projecting into a body of water / n. a sleeveless garment like a cloak but shorter
translation: n. 岬, 海角, 披肩, 斗蓬

definition: n. everything that is included in a collection and that is held or included in something / n. the proportion of a substance that is contained in a mixture or alloy etc.
translation: n. 内容, 满足, 意义, 要旨； a. 满足的, 满意的

definition: n. someone who pays rent to use land or a building or a car that is owned by someone else / n. a holder of buildings or lands by any kind of title (as ownership or lease)
translation: n. 承租人, 房客, 居住者； vt. 租借

definition: v. state emphatically and authoritatively / v. state firmly
translation: v. 宣布, 声明, 申报, 断言
mnemonic: de(彻底) + clar(清晰) + e -> 彻底公开说清楚 -> 宣布，声明，申报。

definition: v. make clear and (more) comprehensible / v. make clear by removing impurities or solids, as by heating
translation: vi. 澄清, 阐明； vt. 使明晰
mnemonic: clar(清晰) + ify(使...) -> 使之清晰明了 -> 阐明，澄清。

definition: n. free from obscurity and easy to understand; the comprehensibility of clear expression
translation: n. 清楚, 明晰； [化] 透明度; 透明性; 清晰性

definition: r. almost not
translation: adv. 刚刚, 几乎不, 勉强是

definition: n. major items of military weaponry (as tanks or missile) / n. instrumentalities (tools or implements) made of metal
translation: n. 硬件, 五金器具, 零件； [计] 硬件

definition: n. something that causes or entails suffering
translation: n. 艰难, 辛苦, 苦难； [法] 受苦, 吃苦, 苦难

definition: v. become hard or harder / v. make hard or harder
translation: vt. 使变硬, 使坚强, 使冷酷； vi. 变硬, 变冷酷

definition: v. argue or speak in defense of / v. be on the defensive; act against an attack
translation: vt. 防护, 辩护, 防卫； [法] 作...的辩护律师, 辩护, 为...答辩
mnemonic: de(去除) + fend(击打) -> 挡开来袭的击打 -> 防御，保卫，辩护。

definition: v cause to feel resentment or indignation / v act in disregard of laws, rules, contracts, or promises
translation: v. 犯罪, 冒犯, 违反, 进攻

definition: n. an abstract part of something / n. an artifact that is one of the individual parts of which a composite entity is made up; especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system
translation: n. 元件, 组件, 成分； a. 组成的, 构成的
mnemonic: com + pon(放置) + ent -> 一起放在里面的组成部件 -> 零部件，成分。

definition: s. characterized by active hostility
translation: n. 对手, 敌手, 反对者； a. 敌对的, 反对的, 对面的

definition: v. hold back to a later time
translation: vt. 延迟, 使延期, 缓办, 搁延； vi. 延缓, 延缓发作

definition: n. the opposition or dissimilarity of things that are compared / n. the act of distinguishing by comparing differences
translation: n. 差别, 对比, 对照物； vt. 使对比
mnemonic: contra(对照) + st(站立) -> 站在对立面互相比较 -> 对比，对照。

definition: n. a contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
translation: n. 论争, 辩论, 论战, 争论； [法] 论战, 争论, 争吵
mnemonic: contro(相对) + vers(转向) + y -> 意见相左引发激烈争辩 -> 争论，争议。

definition: n. opposition between two conflicting forces or ideas / n. (logic) a statement that is necessarily false
translation: n. 反驳, 矛盾； [法] 矛盾, 否认, 反驳

definition: n. exact opposition / n. a logical relation such that two propositions are contraries if both cannot be true but both can be false
translation: a. 相反的, 矛盾的, 对立的； n. 相反, 对立面
mnemonic: contra(相反) + ry -> 走向对立面的 -> 相反的，对抗的。

definition: v. be in contradiction with / v. deny the truth of
translation: vt. 反驳, 与...抵触, 与...矛盾； vi. 反驳
mnemonic: contra(反/相对) + dict(说) -> 反着说否定对方 -> 反驳，与...矛盾。

definition: n. capability to perform or produce / n. the amount that can be contained
translation: n. 容量, 能力, 才能, 资格； [计] 容量
mnemonic: cap(容纳/抓取) + acity -> 能容纳和承担的最大限度 -> 容量，能力。

definition: a. (usually followed by `of') having capacity or ability / s. possibly accepting or permitting
translation: a. 有能力的, 能的, 能干的

definition: n. an animal that is confined / n. a person held in the grip of a strong emotion or passion
translation: n. 俘虏, 迷恋者； a. 被俘的, 被迷住的

definition: n. an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth / n. a judgment of the qualities of something or somebody
translation: n. 估计, 判断； vt. 估计, 评价, 判断
mnemonic: estim(评价/衡量) + ate -> 估量大致数量与价值 -> 估计，估算。

definition: n. the condition of being honored (esteemed or respected or well regarded)
translation: n. 尊敬, 尊重； vt. 尊敬, 尊重, 认为

definition: v. be identical or equivalent to / v. be equal to in quality or ability
translation: n. 对手, 匹敌, 同辈； a. 相等的, 平等的, 胜任的, 合适的, 平静的, 不相上下的
mnemonic: equ(均等) + al -> 毫无二致一视同仁 -> 平等的，相等的。

definition: a. having the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task / s. sufficient for the purpose
translation: a. 适当的, 足够的； [法] 胜任的, 适当的, 充分的
mnemonic: ad(达到) + equ(相等/平衡) + ate -> 刚好达到标准数量 -> 足够的，胜任的。

definition: n. a mathematical statement that two expressions are equal / n. the act of regarding as equal
translation: n. 相等, 等式, 平衡； [化] 方程式; 等式; 反应式; 公式
mnemonic: equ(相等) + ation -> 左右两端平衡的算式 -> 方程式，等式。

definition: n. a person or thing equal to another in value or measure or force or effect or significance etc / n. the atomic weight of an element that has the same combining capacity as a given weight of another
translation: n. 同等物, 等价物, 相等物； a. 相等的, 相当的, 同意义的
mnemonic: equi(相等) + val(价值) + ent -> 具有完全等同价值的 -> 等价的，等同物。

definition: r. at the same time but in another place / r. during the intervening time
translation: n. 其时, 其间； adv. 同时, 于此时

definition: n the time between one event, process, or period and another / r during the intervening time
translation: n. 间隔时间, 其时； adv. 其间

definition: v. establish or strengthen as with new evidence or facts / v. strengthen or make more firm
translation: vt. 证实, 确定, 批准, 使巩固； [计] 确认
mnemonic: con + firm(坚固/确定) -> 进一步加固核实 -> 确认，证实。

definition: v. to declare or affirm solemnly and formally as true / v. say yes to
translation: v. 断言, 确认

definition: n. polished surface that forms images by reflecting light / n. a faithful depiction or reflection
translation: n. 镜子, 写真, 典范； vt. 反映, 映出

definition: v. feel admiration for / v. look at with admiration
translation: vt. 赞美, 钦佩, 爱慕； vi. 称赞, 惊奇

definition: n. any amazing or wonderful occurrence / n. a marvellous event manifesting a supernatural act of a divine agent
translation: n. 奇迹, 奇事
mnemonic: mira(惊奇/赞叹) + cle -> 让人赞叹不已的非凡奇迹 -> 奇迹，令人惊奇的事。

definition: n. the amount of 3-dimensional space occupied by an object / n. a publication that is one of a set of several similar publications
translation: n. 册, 卷, 体积, 容量, 大量, 许多, 份量, 音量； vi. 成团卷起

definition: n. (biology) the sequence of events involved in the evolutionary development of a species or taxonomic group of organisms
translation: n. 进化, 发展, 进展, (气体)放出, 开方； [医] 进化, 演化, 旋出

definition: s. markedly new or introducing radical change / a. relating to or having the nature of a revolution
translation: n. 革命者, 革命党人； a. 革命的, 革命性的

definition: n. composition (often improvised) for a solo instrument (especially solo organ) and not a regular part of a religious service or musical performance / a. of your own free will or design; done by choic
translation: a. 自动的, 自愿的, 故意的, 志愿的, 自发的； n. 自愿行动, 志愿者, 自由调
mnemonic: vol(自愿/意志) + untary -> 出自个人完全自由意志的 -> 自愿的，无偿的。

definition: s causing fear or dread or terror / s exceptionally bad or displeasing
translation: a. 可怕的, 令人恐惧的, 极坏的

definition: n. an area of knowledge or interest / n. the geographical area under the jurisdiction of a sovereign state
translation: n. 领土, 领地, 版图, 地区, 活动范围； [经] (推销员等的)推销区域

definition: n. a person who inspires fear or dread / n. a very troublesome child
translation: n. 恐怖, 可怕的人； [医] 惊吓, 惊悸

definition: s. very great or intense / s. causing extreme terror
translation: a. 非常好的, 极端的, 可怕的
mnemonic: terr(使恐惧/极大震颤) + ific -> 带来巨大震撼极好的 -> 极好的，极大的。

definition: v. fill with terror; frighten greatly
translation: vt. 使恐惧, 恐吓

definition: n. a person of nearly the same age as another / s. characteristic of the present
translation: n. 同时代的人； a. 同时代的, 属于同一时期的
mnemonic: con + tempor(时代/时间) + ary -> 处在同一时代的 -> 当代的，同代人。

definition: n a worker (especially in an office) hired on a temporary basis / a not permanent; not lasting
translation: a. 暂时的, 临时的； n. 临时工, 临时雇员
mnemonic: tempor(时间/暂时) + ary -> 只在一段有限时间内有效的 -> 暂时的，临时的。

definition: n. the product of a quantity by an integer / a. having or involving or consisting of more than one part or entity or individual
translation: n. 倍数, 并联； a. 多样的, 许多的, 多功能的

definition: v. combine by multiplication / v. combine or increase by multiplication
translation: v. 繁殖, 乘, 增加； [计] 乘

definition: n. a large gathering of people / n. the common people generally
translation: n. 多数, 群众
mnemonic: multi(多) + tude -> 汇聚成浩浩荡荡的大群 -> 多数，大群，大众。

definition: n. someone who has committed a crime or has been legally convicted of a crime / s. guilty of crime or serious offense
translation: n. 罪犯, 犯人, 刑事； a. 犯了罪的, 刑事的, 有罪的

definition: v. recognize or perceive the difference / v. treat differently on the basis of sex or race
translation: v. 区别, 差别待遇
mnemonic: dis + crimin(区分/罪) + ate -> 带有偏见地区别对待 -> 歧视，辨别。

definition: n. change toward something smaller or lower / n. a condition inferior to an earlier condition; a gradual falling off from a better state
translation: n. 衰退, 跌落, 下降； vt. 使降低, 婉谢
mnemonic: de(向下) + cline(倾斜) -> 向下倾斜或委婉拒绝 -> 下降，衰退，谢绝。

definition: n. a medical establishment run by a group of medical specialists / n. meeting for diagnosis of problems and instruction or remedial work in a particular activity
translation: n. 诊所, 临床教学； [医] 诊所(门诊部); 临床(讲解); 临床(学)科

definition: n. the highest point of anything conceived of as growing or developing or unfolding / n. the decisive moment in a novel or play
translation: n. 高潮, 极点, 层进法； v. (使)达到顶点, (使)达到高潮

definition: v. bend or turn (one's ear) towards a speaker in order to listen well / v. lower or bend (the head or upper body), as in a nod or bow
translation: n. 倾斜, 斜坡, 斜面； vt. 使倾向于, 使倾斜
mnemonic: in + cline(倾斜/心向) -> 心思倾斜偏向某一边 -> 倾向于，倾斜。

definition: n. the exposure of an impostor or a fraud / v. expose or make accessible to some action or influence
translation: vt. 使暴露, 使曝光, 揭穿, 陈列； [医] 暴露, 露置
mnemonic: ex(出) + pose(摆放) -> 摆在太阳底下完全暴露 -> 暴露，揭露，曝光。

definition: n. (logic) a statement that affirms or denies something and is either true or false / n. an offer for a private bargain (especially a request for sexual favors)
translation: n. 建议, 命题, 主张； vt. 向...提议, 向...提出猥亵的要求

definition: n. a narrow strait connecting two bodies of water / v. make or become more narrow or restricted
translation: n. 狭窄部分, 隘路； a. 狭窄的, 仔细的, 有限的, 勉强的, 狭隘的, 手紧的

definition: n. a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program / s. consisting of or characterized by
translation: n. 叙述, 故事； a. 叙述的, 叙事的, 故事体的

definition: v. provide commentary for a film, for example
translation: v. 说故事, 说明, 叙述

definition: v. attain success or reach a desired goal / v. be the successor (of)
translation: vi. 成功, 继承, 继续； vt. 继承, 接替

definition: v. move ahead; travel onward in time or space / v. follow a certain course
translation: vi. 继续进行, 进行, 开始, 发出, 起诉； [法] 所得, 收入, 收益
mnemonic: pro(向前) + ceed(走) -> 继往开来继续向前推进 -> 继续进行，前进。

definition: v. be greater in scope or size than some standard / v. be superior or better than some standard
translation: vt. 超过, 超越, 胜过； vi. 超过其他
mnemonic: ex(超出) + ceed(走) -> 走到界限之外超越标准 -> 超过，超出。

definition: v. have a celebration
translation: v. 庆祝, 祝贺, 举行

definition: n. a widely known person
translation: n. 名声, 名人

definition: n. a string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language / v. pronounce a sentence on (somebody) in a court of law
translation: n. 句子, 命题, 宣判； vt. 宣判, 判决

definition: n. tender, romantic, or nostalgic feeling or emotion
translation: n. 感情, 感伤, 情操, 情绪, 感想, 意见； [医] 情感, 情操
mnemonic: sent(感受) + iment -> 蕴含在内心的细腻情绪与感伤 -> 情绪，情感，感伤。

definition: n. permission to do something
translation: n. 同意, 许可； vi. 同意, 赞同
mnemonic: con + sent(感觉/赞同) -> 同意对方的感觉与提议 -> 同意，赞成。

definition: v. feel bitter or indignant about
translation: vt. 愤恨, 憎恶, 怨恨
mnemonic: re(反向) + sent(感觉) -> 心里充满抗拒反感 -> 怨恨，愤恨。

definition: s. given to or marked by sentiment or sentimentality
translation: a. 感伤的, 感情用事的

definition: n. a full supply
translation: n. 充分, 很多, 丰富； a. 很多的, 足够的, 丰富的

definition: s. existing in great number or quantity
translation: a. 许多的, 丰富的, 丰饶的

definition: n. a component that is added to something to improve it / n. the act of adding one thing to another
translation: n. 加法, 增加的人(或物)； [计] 加法

definition: a. of or relating to an article stating opinions or giving perspectives / a. relating to or characteristic of an editor
translation: n. 社论, 评论； a. 编辑的, 主笔的, 社论的

definition: a. having the ability or power to create / s. promoting construction or creation
translation: a. 有创造力的, 创作的, 产生的

definition: n. a human being; `wight' is an archaic term / n. a person who is controlled by others and is used to perform unpleasant or dishonest tasks for someone else
translation: n. 人, 动物, 创造物, 生物

definition: n an activity that diverts or amuses or stimulates / n activity that refreshes and recreates; activity that renews your health and spirits by enjoyment and relaxation
translation: n. 娱乐, 消遣, 休息, 再创造； [医] 娱乐, 休养

definition: s. necessitating a choice between mutually exclusive possibilities / s. pertaining to unconventional choices
translation: n. 两者择一, 供替代的选择； a. 两者择一的, 供选择的

definition: v. go back and forth; swing back and forth between two states or conditions / v. exchange people temporarily to fulfill certain jobs and functions
translation: a. 交替的, 轮流的, 间隔的； v. 轮流, (使)交替

definition: n an integrated course of academic studies
translation: n. 课程； [医] 课程, 学程

definition: n. the metal or paper medium of exchange that is presently used / n. general acceptance or use
translation: n. 货币, 通货, 流通, 通用； [计] 货币, 货币型

definition: n. an instance of something occurring
translation: n. 发生, 事件, 出现； [医] 发生

definition: s recurring again and again
translation: a. 再发生的, 定期重复的, 循环的； [医] 复发的, 再发的, 回归的

definition: n. a traveler riding in a vehicle (a boat or bus or car or plane or train etc) who is not operating it
translation: n. 乘客, 旅客； [经] 乘客, 旅客

definition: n. a strong feeling or emotion / n. a feeling of strong sexual desire
translation: n. 激情, 酷爱, 热爱, 强烈感情, 耶稣受难(故事)

definition: n. the rate of moving (especially walking or running) / n. the relative speed of progress or change
translation: n. 速度, 步调, 步法； vi. 踱步, 缓慢走

definition: v. be or do something to a greater degree
translation: vt. 超越, 凌驾, 胜过
mnemonic: sur(超过) + pass(通过) -> 走在前面彻底超越 -> 超越，胜过。

definition: n. navigational instrument for finding directions / n. the limit of capability
translation: n. 指南针, 范围, 音域； vt. 包围, 达到, 图谋, 理解

definition: n. a person who passes by casually or by chance
translation: n. 过路人, 行人

definition: n. a writer for newspapers and magazines
translation: n. 新闻记者, 从事新闻杂志业的人

definition: n. the act of traveling from one place to another
translation: n. 旅程, 旅行, 行程； vi. 旅行

definition: n. a periodical dedicated to a particular subject / n. a record book as a physical object
translation: n. 日记, 杂志, 日报； [化] 轴颈

definition: n. someone who is under suspicion / v. imagine to be the case or true or probable
translation: n. 被怀疑者, 嫌疑犯； a. 令人怀疑的, 不可信的, 可疑的
mnemonic: sus/sub(暗中) + spect(看) -> 暗地里打量怀疑其动机 -> 怀疑，嫌疑人。

definition: v. supply with necessities and support / v. admit as valid
translation: vt. 承受, 支持, 供养, 继续, 忍受, 蒙受, 证实, 准许； [电] 持续
mnemonic: sus/sub(在底下) + tain(握住/托住) -> 在底下稳稳托住维系持久 -> 维持，支撑，遭受。

definition: n. a formal message requesting something that is submitted to an authority / n. the verbal act of requesting
translation: n. 请求, 需要, 申请书； vt. 请求, 要求, 邀请

definition: n. a form containing a set of questions; submitted to people to gain statistical information
translation: n. 调查表, 问卷； [经] 调查表

definition: a. subject to question / s. able to be refuted
translation: a. 可疑的； [法] 可疑的, 有问题的, 不可靠的

definition: n. the act of conquering / n. success in mastering something difficult
translation: n. 战胜, 征服, 战利品； [法] 征服, 赢得, 获得

definition: a relating to or using sight / s visible; give me the ocular proof"- Shakespeare
translation: a. 视觉的； [医] 视觉的, 视力的, 视觉性记忆优势者

definition: v. make revisions in
translation: n. 校订, 修正, 改样； vt. 校订, 修正, 校正
mnemonic: re(再次) + vis(看) + e -> 再次审视修改草稿 -> 修订，修改，复习。

definition: n. (psychology) a state of mental or emotional strain or suspense / n. the physical condition of being stretched or strained
translation: n. 紧张, 不安, 拉紧, 张力, 压力, 电压； vt. 拉紧, 使紧张

definition: n. the amount of energy transmitted (as by acoustic or electromagnetic radiation) / n. high level or degree; the property of being intense
translation: n. 强烈, 紧张, 强度； [计] 强度; 亮度

definition: n. a grammatical category of verbs used to express distinctions of time / v. increase the tension on
translation: a. 紧张的, 拉紧的； v. (使)紧张, (使)拉紧

definition: n. arid land with little or no vegetation / v. leave behind
translation: n. 沙漠, 应得的赏罚, 功劳； a. 沙漠的, 不毛的

definition: v. state categorically / v. insist on having one's opinions and rights recognized
translation: vt. 主张, 坚称, 断言； [法] 宣称, 断言, 维护
mnemonic: as + sert(加入/连接) -> 坚定地把观点插入 -> 断言，坚称。

definition: n. a folded section placed between the leaves of another publication / n. an artifact that is inserted or is to be inserted
translation: n. 插入物； vt. 插入, 把(人造卫星)射入(轨道), 添写

definition: v. put to use / v. make a great effort at a mental or physical task
translation: vt. 发挥, 运用, 施以影响； [法] 施加, 产生, 行使
mnemonic: ex + sert(加入/连接) -> 将全身力量连结释放出来 -> 施加，运用，努力。

definition: n. a misconception resulting from incorrect information / n. (baseball) a failure of a defensive player to make an out when normal play would have sufficed

definition: n. a white sparkling wine either produced in Champagne or resembling that produced there / n. a region of northeastern France
translation: n. 香槟酒, 香槟酒色； [化] 香槟酒

definition: n. a magnifier of images of distant objects / v. crush together or collapse
translation: n. 望远镜； vi. 叠缩, 嵌进, 缩短

definition: n. a message transmitted by telegraph
translation: n. 电报, 一封电报； [计] 电报

definition: n. apparatus used to communicate at a distance over a wire (usually in Morse code)

definition: s extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree; that a whole civilization should be dependent on technology"- Walter Lippman / s extraordinarily good or great; used especially
translation: a. 巨大的, 非常的, 可怕的

definition: n. a reflex motion caused by cold or fear or excitement / v. move or jerk quickly and involuntarily up and down or sideways
translation: n. 战栗, 颤抖； vi. 战栗, 忧虑, 摇晃

definition: n. the line or plane indicating the limit or extent of something / n. a line determining the limits of an area

definition: n. the quality of a substance that is able to rebound / n. rebounding from an impact (or series of impacts)
translation: n. 跳, 跳跃, 弹力, 撞击； vi. 反跳, 弹跳

definition: n a device that can be used to control a machine or apparatus from a distance / s located far away spatially
translation: a. 遥远的, 偏僻的, 疏远的, 微少的； [计] 远程, 远程访问实用程序
mnemonic: re(向后) + mote(移动) -> 移到极远处遥不可及的 -> 偏远的，遥远的，微弱的。

definition: n. machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical energy and so imparts motion / n. a nonspecific agent that imparts motion
translation: n. 马达, 发动机, 原动力, 汽车； a. 马达的, 发动机的, 汽车的, 发动的

definition: v. give an incentive for action
translation: vt. 给与动机, 刺激, 提高...的学习欲望, 促动； [经] 促动, 激发, 激励
mnemonic: mot(移动/动力) + ivate -> 激发内心向前的源动力 -> 激励，激发。

definition: s. causing or able to cause motion
translation: n. 动机, 目的, 主题, 基调； a. 运动的, 成为动机的

definition: n. the contentment one feels when one has fulfilled a desire, need, or expectation / n. (law) the payment of a debt or fulfillment of an obligation
translation: n. 满足, 满意, 快事, 赔偿, 赎罪, 报仇的机会； [经] 偿还, 赎回

definition: v. meet the requirements or expectations of / v. make happy or satisfied
translation: vt. 使满意, 满足, 符合, 使确信, 赔偿； vi. 令人满意, 替人赎罪

definition: a. giving satisfaction / s. meeting requirements
translation: a. 满意的, 赎罪的； [法] 令人满意的, 令当事人满意的, 充分的

definition: v. cause (a chemical compound, vapour, solution, magnetic material) to unite with the greatest possible amount of another substance
translation: vt. 使渗透, 浸透, 使充满, 使饱和； a. 浸透的, 饱和度高的, 深颜色的
mnemonic: satur(饱足) + ate -> 吸满水分达到完全饱和 -> 使饱和，浸透。

definition: s common to or shared by two or more parties / a concerning each of two or more persons or things; especially given or done in return
translation: a. 相互的, 共有的； [经] 相互的
mnemonic: mut(交换) + ual -> 双方互相交换付出的 -> 相互的，共同的。

definition: n. a regular journey of some distance to and from your place of work / v. exchange positions without a change in value
translation: vt. 交换, 折偿, 减轻； vi. 代偿, 经常乘车来往

definition: a. having a bearing on or connection with the subject at issue
translation: a. 有关联的, 有关系的, 适当的, 相应的； [法] 有关的, 相关的

definition: v. provide physical relief, as from pain / v. free from a burden, evil, or distress
translation: vt. 减轻, 救济, 解除, 使免除, 换...的班, 使得到调剂, 使不单调, 衬托, 使显著； vi. 救济, 当替补投手, 呈鲜明突出
mnemonic: re + liev(变轻) -> 卸下重担让人身心变轻 -> 缓解，减轻，救济。

definition: v give a promotion to or assign to a higher position / v raise from a lower to a higher position
translation: vt. 举起, 提拔, 鼓舞
mnemonic: e(向外) + lev(变轻/升起) + ate -> 升起抬高到更高层次 -> 提升，举起，振奋。

definition: n. a rigid bar pivoted about a fulcrum / n. a simple machine that gives a mechanical advantage when given a fulcrum
translation: n. 杠杆, 似杠杆之工具； vt. 撬开

definition: n. a charge imposed and collected / n. the act of drafting into military service
translation: n. 税款, 所征的人数, 征收； vi. 征税, 课税

definition: n. a written agreement between two states or sovereigns
translation: n. 条约, 谈判； [经] 协议, 协定, 协商

definition: n. (military) withdrawal of troops to a more favorable position to escape the enemy's superior forces or after a defeat / n. a place of privacy; a place affording peace and quiet
translation: n. 休息寓所, 撤退, 隐居, 退避； vi. 撤退, 隐退, 向后倾
mnemonic: re(向后) + treat/tract(拉) -> 军队向后撤拉 -> 撤退，退避，隐居处。

definition: n. (geology) a crack in the earth's crust resulting from the displacement of one side with respect to the other / n. (electronics) equipment failure attributable to some defect in a circuit (loose con
translation: n. 过错, 故障, 毛病； vt. 挑剔

definition: s. characterized by errors; not agreeing with a model or not following established rules; the wrong side of the road"
translation: a. 有过失的, 有缺点的, 不完美的, 应受责备的； [经] 缺点多的

definition: v. form or compose
translation: vt. 构成, 组成, 任命； [建] 构造, 组成
mnemonic: con + stitut(设立/建立) + e -> 共同建立构成整体 -> 构成，组成，设立。

definition: n an act passed by a legislative body / s enacted by a legislative body
translation: n. 法令, 成文法律, 法规, 章程, 条例； [法] 法令, 法规, 成文法

definition: n. a person or thing that takes or can take the place of another / n. an athlete who plays only when a starter on the team is replaced
translation: n. 代理, 代理人, 代用品, 代替者, 代替物； vt. 代替
mnemonic: sub(在下面/代替) + stitut(站立) + e -> 站上去替代主力上场 -> 替代品，代替。

definition: n. an association organized to promote art or science or education / v. advance or set forth in court
translation: n. 学会, 学院, 协会； vt. 创立, 开始, 制定, 任命
mnemonic: in + stitut(设立/建立) + e -> 建立设立的研究机构或制度 -> 研究所，学会，制定。

definition: n. a person who has been converted to another religious or political belief / v. change from one system to another or to a new plan or policy
translation: n. 皈依者, 改变宗教信仰者； vt. 使改变信仰, 转换, 兑换, 倒置

definition: n. something that is oriented vertically / a. at right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line
translation: a. 垂直的, 直立的； [医] 垂直的, 顶的, 头顶的
mnemonic: vert(转动/头顶最高点) + ical -> 与地平线呈 90 度垂直的 -> 垂直的，竖直的。

definition: v. call attention to / v. make publicity for; try to sell (a product)
translation: vt. 做广告, 通知, 公布； vi. 做广告

translation: vt. 转移, 使欢娱； vi. 转移

definition: v. turn away or aside
translation: vt. 转开, 避免, 防止

definition: v. make an inversion (in a musical composition) / v. reverse the position, order, relation, or condition of
translation: a. 转化的； vt. 使反转, 使颠倒, 使转化

definition: s having a quality that thrusts itself into attention / s conspicuous in position or importance
translation: a. 卓越的, 显著的, 突出的, 凸出的

definition: s. standing above others in quality or position / s. of imposing height; especially standing out above others
translation: a. 显赫的, 杰出的, 有名的

definition: s. performing an essential function in the living body / s. manifesting or characteristic of life
translation: a. 生命的, 重要的, 充满活力的, 生死攸关的, 致命的； [医] 生命的, 生活的, 生活上必需的, 紧要的
mnemonic: vit(生命) + al -> 关乎生死存亡极其重要的 -> 极其重要的，充满活力的。

definition: n. any of a group of organic substances essential in small quantities to normal metabolism
translation: n. 维生素； [化] 维生素

definition: n an event (or a course of events) that will inevitably happen in the future / n the ultimate agency regarded as predetermining the course of events (often personified as a woman)
translation: n. 命运, 运气； vt. 注定

definition: s. extremely pleasing / s. based on or told of in traditional stories; lacking factual basis or historical validity
translation: a. 传说的, 寓言般的, 难以置信的

definition: n. a short moral story (often with animal characters)
translation: n. 寓言, 神话, 谎言； vi. 虚构, 作寓言

definition: n a short introductory essay preceding the text of a book / v furnish with a preface or introduction
translation: n. 序, 绪言, 前言； vi. 作序, 写前言

definition: n. a person who has radical ideas or opinions / n. (mathematics) a quantity expressed as the root of another quantity
translation: n. 激进分子, 词根, 基础, 根式, 根； a. 激进的, 根本的, 基本的, 根的

definition: r. in a radical manner
translation: adv. 根本地, 完全地

definition: n. imagination unrestricted by reality / n. fiction with a large amount of imagination in it
translation: n. 幻想, 想象的产物； [医] 幻想

definition: s. extraordinarily good or great; used especially as intensifiers / s. fanciful and unrealistic; foolish
translation: a. 奇妙的, 稀奇的, 空想的

definition: n. a kind of imagination that was held by Coleridge to be more casual and superficial than true imagination / v. have a fancy or particular liking or desire for
translation: n. 想象力, 幻想, 喜好； a. 想象的, 精美的, 新奇的, 奇特的, 高价的, 特级的

definition: n. motion of hands or body to emphasize or help to express a thought or feeling / n. the use of movements (especially of the hands) to communicate familiar or prearranged signals
translation: n. 手势, 姿态； vi. 作手势, 作姿态

translation: n. 寄存器, 记录, 登记簿, 注册； vt. 记录, 注册, 提示, 表达, 把...挂号

translation: n. 心理学, 心理状态； [医] 心理学

definition: n. the branch of medicine dealing with the diagnosis and treatment of mental disorders
translation: n. 精神病学, 精神病治疗； [医] 精神病学

definition: a. beyond belief or understanding
translation: a. 难以置信的
mnemonic: in(不) + cred(相信) + ible -> 令人难以置信的精彩绝伦 -> 难以置信的，极好的。

definition: n a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts
translation: n. 国书, 凭据, 证明书； [经] 凭证, 证书

definition: n a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts / n a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts
translation: n. 信任状, 国书, 文件, 身份证明, 证书； [法] 信用证, 国书, 证书

definition: v. give an education to / v. teach or refine to be discriminative in taste or judgment
translation: vt. 教育, 培养, 训练

definition: v. cause to arise / v. cause to do; cause to act in a specified manner
translation: vt. 引诱, 招致, 归纳出, 感应； [医] 诱导, 感应
mnemonic: in + duce(引出/引导) -> 循循善诱引出结果 -> 诱导，引起，引产。

definition: v. reason by deduction; establish by deduction / v. conclude by reasoning; in logic
translation: vt. 推论, 演绎出； [法] 推断, 推出, 演绎
mnemonic: de(从...向下) + duce(引出) -> 从前提向下推导出结论 -> 推论，演绎。

definition: v. obtain / v. come from
translation: vt. 得自； vi. 起源

definition: n. the contestant you hope to defeat / v. be the rival of, be in competition with
translation: n. 对手, 竞争者； a. 竞争的

definition: v. appear like; be similar or bear a likeness to
translation: vt. 相似, 类似

definition: n. a group of machine parts that fit together to form a self-contained unit / n. a group of persons who are gathered together for a common purpose
translation: n. 与会者, 集会, 装配, 组件； [化] 装配

definition: a. having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire / s. intellectually appealing

mnemonic: soph(智慧) + isticated -> 历经世事极其老练精密复杂的 -> 复杂的，精密的，老练的。

definition: n. a specialist in philosophy / n. a wise person who is calm and rational; someone who lives a life of reason with equanimity
translation: n. 哲学家, 哲人, 思想开创人, 达观的人； [法] 哲学家, 哲学研究者

definition: v. cause to burst with a violent release of energy / v. burst outward, usually with noise
translation: vi. 爆炸, 爆发, 激增； vt. 使爆炸
mnemonic: ex(出) + plaud/plod(拍手/爆破声) -> 伴随巨响炸裂开来 -> 爆炸，爆发。

definition: a. apparently reasonable and valid, and truthful / s. given to or characterized by presenting specious arguments
translation: a. 貌似真实的, 貌似合理的, 说得煞有其事的； [法] 花言巧语的, 似乎有理的
mnemonic: plaus(鼓掌赞同) + ible -> 听起来值得鼓掌看似很有道理的 -> 貌似合理的，巧言令色的。

definition: n. serial arrangement in which things follow in logical order or a recurrent pattern / n. a following of one thing after another in time
translation: n. 序列, 续发事件, 顺序, 连续； vt. 按顺序排好
mnemonic: sequ(跟随) + ence -> 一个接一个按序跟随而来的排列 -> 序列，顺序，连续。

definition: a. following in time or order
translation: a. 后来的, 接下去的； [经] 后来的
mnemonic: sub(在后) + sequ(跟随) + ent -> 紧随其后随之而来的 -> 随后的，后来的。

definition: v. come together as in a cluster or flock
translation: n. 串, 丛, 群, 簇； vi. 成串, 丛生

definition: a. including much or everything; and especially including stated limits

definition: n. a break or intermission in the occurrence of something / v. end, at least for a long time

definition: n. the quality or state of being mortal

definition: a. subject to death / s. unrelenting and deadly
translation: n. 生物, 人类； a. 不免一死的, 人类的, 临终的

definition: n. the type of environment in which an organism or group normally lives or occurs
translation: n. 栖息地, 居留地, 自生地, 聚集处； [医] 习生地, 产地, 生境, 栖所

definition: n. a person who inhabits a particular place
translation: n. 居民, 居住者； [医] 居民

definition: n. a meeting of heads of governments / v. reach the summit (of a mountain)
translation: n. 顶点, 最高阶层, 最高级会议； a. 政府首脑的, 最高级的

definition: n. a brief statement that presents the main points in a concise form
translation: n. 摘要, 概要； a. 摘要的, 简略的

definition: v. be a summary of
translation: v. 概述, 总结

definition: v. preside over / v. make less fast or intense
translation: a. 适度的, 稳健的, 中等的, 节制的； vt. 节制, 减轻, 使缓和

definition: n. making modern in appearance or behavior / n. a modernized version (as of a play)
translation: n. 现代化

definition: n. the act of invading; the act of an army that invades for conquest or plunder / n. any entry into an area not previously occupied
translation: n. 侵犯, 侵入, 侵害； [医] 侵袭, 侵入, 发病

definition: v. march aggressively into another's territory by military force for the purposes of conquest and occupation / v. occupy in large numbers or live on a host
translation: vt. 侵入, 拥入, 侵略, 侵袭； [法] 强入, 侵犯, 侵略
mnemonic: in + vade(走/迈步) -> 大踏步冲入别国领土 -> 侵略，侵犯。

definition: v. practice evasion / v. use cunning or deceit to escape or avoid
translation: v. (巧妙地)逃脱, 规避, 逃避

definition: n. intense and profound fear / n. something that inspires dislike; something horrible
translation: n. 惊骇, 恐怖, 惨状； [医] 恐怖, 恐惧

definition: s provoking horror

definition: a. concerned with religion or religious purposes / s. worthy of respect or dedication
translation: a. 神圣的, 献给上帝的, 庄严的, 祭祀的； [法] 神圣的, 不可侵犯的

definition: n. personnel that are sacrificed (e.g., surrendered or lost in order to gain an objective) / n. a loss entailed by giving up or selling something at less than its value
translation: n. 牺牲, 供奉, 祭品； vt. 牺牲, 祭祀, 贱卖

definition: a. of or being or relating to or involving cognition

definition: v. inform

definition: n. someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)
